services.value: Eurofins provides analytical testing services across multiple industries, including Life (Food and Feed Testing, Environment Testing, Agro Testing, Sensory and Consumer Research) and BioPharma (BioPharma Services, Agroscience Services, Genomic Services, Forensic Services, Product Testing). The page also lists Contract Development & Manufacturing Organisation (CDMO) and PSS Insourcing Solutions®, along with other offerings such as Diagnostic Services & Products and Consumer Product Testing.
